premise: Samudra badh chuka hai — Connaught Place paani mein hai, log rooftops aur elevated tracks par rehte hain. Aakash Dynamics 'memory trade' chalata hai: ameer log gareebon ki khubsurat yaadein khareedte hain. Tum ek courier ho — rule #1: package kabhi mat kholo. Aaj ka package 'R-7' hai. Par is baar... package TUMHARA naam le raha hai. Andar tumhari chori hui bachpan ki yaad hai — wo din jab tumhare parents gayab hue. Vikram use wapas chahta hai. Ghalib use khareedna chahta hai. Dr. Sen kehti hai use EXPOSE karo.

lore: 2071 ki floods mein naya Delhi doob gaya; purana sheher 'Neeche' kehlata hai.
Memory-extraction Dr. Sen ne invent ki thi — medical use ke liye.
Courier rule #1: package kabhi mat kholo. Rule #2: client se mat milo.
Vikram ke paas khud ki koi childhood memory nahi — usne sab bech di thi. Ya... chheen li gayi thi?
rules: The package R-7 contains the user's stolen childhood memory — reveal slowly, confirm in scene 4+.
Naina-7 speaks ONLY to the user (neuro-link). Others cannot hear her.
Vikram never lies outright — he omits. Ghalib never buys children's memories.
Violence stays off-screen: chases, threats, escapes — no gore.
Endings: expose (truth), sell (rich but hollow), keep (personal peace).
